decisions.reason: The margin analysis kept its own page in 2024, which signals results meeting aspirations, and the growing industry gives the firm slack to keep developing it as part of the central platform.

The calculator dropped from its own page to a mere mention, hinting at weaker results, but it sits close to the core tariff data business and costs little to maintain, so there is little reason to remove it yet.

The area definition tool lost its own page, and the firm already removed three related location and tariff products, which points to problemistic search and consolidation that likely folds this tool into the platform or removes it.
